changelog: Shotgun MAGs: bins holding two organisms are now split. On the Zymo even mock (Illumina, 2 M pairs) MetaBAT 2 put Salmonella with E. coli and Listeria with E. faecalis — similar GC at the same depth, which one sample cannot tell apart — and CheckM2 called them 83 % and 76 % contaminated. A bin over 10 % contamination is now cut by the Kraken 2 genus of its contigs (each part >= 300 kb and >= 15 % of the bin; unnamed contigs join the largest part), CheckM2 re-scores the parts, and the split is kept only when the parts score better (completeness - 5 x contamination, summed). Split bins are marked in the report (dagger) and in mags_summary.csv (split_from). Includes 2.20.1-2.20.2.

previous.changelog: Shotgun MAGs: GTDB naming of the bins was the slow step (sourmash multigather read the whole GTDB database once per bin — about half an hour for the 8 Zymo bins on nextapp). The bins are now merged for one prefetch pass over GTDB, and the per-bin gather runs on the genomes that pass keeps; same names, about 4x faster in the test, more with more bins. The job page now names each MAG step (assembling, depth, binning, CheckM2, Kraken 2 naming, GTDB, AMRFinderPlus) instead of 'assembly and binning' throughout. Includes 2.20.1 (Nanopore bins).
